title_record: Mapping the potential northern limits and promotion extent of ratoon rice in China
what_it_demonstrates: Maps potential northern limits and safe/risky promotion areas of a specific rice system (ratoon rice) in China with a MaxEnt model
what_it_does_not: Does not test how the mapped limit depends on reference construction, climate source or grid support; no land denominator
contribution_of_this_study: Decomposes the dependence of a cold-region bound on quantile, location, period, temporal aggregation and resolution (Germany 3% vs 97%) and reports exposure of an explicit incumbent-arable denominator

title_record: Effects of climate change on paddy expansion and potential adaption strategies for sustainable agriculture development across Northeast China
what_it_demonstrates: Satellite-mapped paddy expansion into mid-high latitudes of Northeast China (net +2.6×10^4 km² 1990–2018) alongside northward isotherm shifts
what_it_does_not: Not a transfer assessment for regions without paddy tradition; does not separate thermal from infrastructure gates
contribution_of_this_study: Screens a region with almost no paddy and separates thermal compatibility from irrigation infrastructure and rainfed balance; claims no observed expansion

title_record: Climate warming and land use change in Heilongjiang Province, Northeast China
what_it_demonstrates: Associates climate warming with land-use change toward paddy in Heilongjiang
what_it_does_not: No causal identification; no infrastructure or water allocation analysis
contribution_of_this_study: Treats the observed Chinese case only as context; does not infer a European trajectory

title_record: Land suitability projections for traditional sub-alpine cropping in the Australian Alps and Chilean Dry Andes. A combined biophysical and irrigation potential perspective
what_it_demonstrates: Projects biophysical and catchment irrigation-potential suitability for traditional sub-alpine cropping; irrigation-potential deficits drive suitability loss more than farm-level biophysics
what_it_does_not: Uses weighted multi-criteria suitability; no test of threshold reference construction
contribution_of_this_study: Applies the same insight (water access binds before climate) with non-compensatory gates on a continental denominator, and quantifies reference-construction sensitivity of the thermal gate

title_record: Spatially-explicit sensitivity analysis for land suitability evaluation
what_it_demonstrates: Spatially explicit sensitivity metric for MCDM land-suitability evaluation (wheat): robust overall but locally sensitive
what_it_does_not: Sensitivity to criteria weights, not to climate source, reference quantile or grid support
contribution_of_this_study: Shows a comparable 'globally stable, locally sensitive' pattern for resolution, but that reference construction, not weights or resolution, drives national outcomes

title_record: Multi-criteria, multi-objective and uncertainty analysis for agro-energy spatial modelling
what_it_demonstrates: GIS multi-criteria land capability for energy-crop conversion with simulation-based uncertainty analysis (Yorkshire and the Humber)
what_it_does_not: Weighted, compensatory framework; uncertainty in inputs, not in reference definition
contribution_of_this_study: Uses non-compensatory gates and explicit reference-construction decomposition; no allocation optimum claimed

title_record: Grain-cropping suitability for evaluating the agricultural land use change in Brazil
dimensions: suitability index vs observed land-use change
what_it_demonstrates: Grain-cropping suitability index (climate, soil, terrain, crop simulation) compared with historical land-use change in Brazil
what_it_does_not: Does not address transfer of a cultivation system or infrastructure gates
contribution_of_this_study: Adds a system-specific transfer reference and infrastructure gate; validates against observed European rice distribution only as consistency

title_record: Suitability mapping framework for solar photovoltaic pumps for smallholder farmers in sub-Saharan Africa
what_it_demonstrates: Multi-criteria GIS suitability for solar PV irrigation pumps in Ethiopia; water-resource accessibility drives scenarios; checked against well-depth data
what_it_does_not: Targets a technology, not a crop transfer; weighted overlay
contribution_of_this_study: Treats mapped irrigation equipment (GMIA AEI) as a necessary but not sufficient gate and distinguishes it from allocable water

title_record: Land suitability evaluation for changing spatial organization in Urmia County towards conservation of Urmia Lake
what_it_demonstrates: GIS multi-stage land suitability to relocate agricultural/residential development away from Urmia Lake
contribution_of_this_study: Treats basin water sustainability as unresolved and makes no allocation claim

title_record: Irrigation expansion and dynamics of desertification in the Circum-Aral region of Central Asia
what_it_demonstrates: Documents desertification dynamics following large-scale irrigation expansion in the Aral region
contribution_of_this_study: Motivates the refusal to equate river discharge with allocable irrigation water

title_record: Taking account of uncertainties in digital land suitability assessment
what_it_demonstrates: Propagating input uncertainty changes an enterprise suitability assessment from 56% suitable (error-free) to mostly unsuitable in simulations
what_it_does_not: Input-error uncertainty, not reference construction or spatial support
contribution_of_this_study: Complements input uncertainty with reference-construction uncertainty of a single binding threshold

title_record: Land-use Suitability is Not an Intrinsic Property of a Land Parcel
dimensions: suitability as a relational, not intrinsic, property
what_it_demonstrates: Land-use suitability evaluated with productive potential, relative contribution and pressure indicators; suitability depends on receiving environments
contribution_of_this_study: Supports framing suitability as dependent on the reference and context in which it is defined

title_record: Global Agricultural Land Resources – A High Resolution Suitability Evaluation and Its Perspectives until 2100 under Climate Change Conditions
dimensions: global high-resolution crop suitability incl. rice
what_it_demonstrates: Global fuzzy-logic suitability for 16 crops at 30″ including irrigated areas, current and future climate
what_it_does_not: No system-specific (cold-region japonica) transfer reference; no decomposition of threshold construction
contribution_of_this_study: System-specific calibration of the thermal bound and explicit irrigation-infrastructure gate

title_record: CropSuite v1.0 – a comprehensive open-source crop suitability model considering climate variability for climate impact assessment
what_it_demonstrates: CropSuite: open-source crop suitability model including climate variability and spatial downscaling
what_it_does_not: General model; not a decomposition of a transferred threshold
contribution_of_this_study: Positions the decomposition as complementary to model-based suitability

what_it_demonstrates: Global rainfed crop-area migration (1973–2012) has moderated growing-season warming exposure; irrigation expansion also contributed
what_it_does_not: Observed migration, not a forward screen; no gate separation
contribution_of_this_study: Forward pre-feasibility screen for transfer of a system; separates thermal and infrastructure constraints

title_record: Northward shift of the agricultural climate zone under 21st-century global climate change
dimensions: GDD-based northward shift of agricultural climate zones
what_it_demonstrates: Uses GDD thresholds with GCM scenarios to delineate northward expansion of small-cereal climate zones
what_it_does_not: Single climate gate; threshold taken as fixed
contribution_of_this_study: Shows that the GDD threshold itself depends on how the reference is constructed

title_record: Climate analogues suggest limited potential for intensification of production on current croplands under climate change
what_it_demonstrates: Climate analogues combined with attainable yields suggest limited intensification potential on current cropland
what_it_does_not: Analogue climate, not system transfer with infrastructure

title_record: The modifiable areal unit problem and implications for landscape ecology
what_it_demonstrates: Classic statement of the modifiable areal unit problem for landscape ecology
contribution_of_this_study: Separates resolution/aggregation (MAUP) from reference-construction effects and shows the latter dominate here

title_record: A global data set of the extent of irrigated land from 1900 to 2005
what_it_demonstrates: Historical gridded area equipped for irrigation 1900–2005 at 5′
what_it_does_not: Equipment extent, not water availability or rice readiness
contribution_of_this_study: Uses AEI only as a screening gate and states its limits
